page.content:
Yeoman outlaw, master of the longbow, leader of the band.

How Robin of Sherwood connects

  • Faction: Merry Men — Robin leads the Merry Men.
  • Artist: Sheriff of Nottingham — The Sheriff of Nottingham hunts Robin through the cycle.
  • Weapon: Longbow — Robin is defined by mastery of the longbow.
  • Event: Archery contest — Robin wins the contest in disguise.
  • Character: Guy of Gisborne — Guy of Gisborne is hired to take Robin and dies in the attempt.
  • Artist: King Richard — Richard pardons Robin after testing the band in disguise.
  • Character: Maid Marian — Marian is Robin's partner in the later greenwood household.
  • Character: Bishop of Hereford — Robin waylays the Bishop of Hereford on the road.
  • Location: Locksley — Later biography makes Robin a man of Locksley.

What is Robin of Sherwood?

Robin — Robyn Hode in the ballads, later Earl of Huntingdon or Robert of Locksley — is the archer-captain who robs churchmen and agents of bad law and keeps a rough hospitality in the wood.

Key threads lead to Merry Men, Sheriff of Nottingham, Longbow, Archery contest, Guy of Gisborne and King Richard.
